messages:
sam: Heads up — our OSS scanner flagged CVE-2026-12345 in thrift-serializer. PoC is public, looks reliable. Affects hosted inference pipeline image using thrift v1.2.3. Need triage + schedule.

alex: CVSS? impact surface? :eyes:

sam: CVSS 7.8. Exploit requires crafted payload to serializer layer; could cause arbitrary deserialization of request metadata. May lead to data exposure for in-flight requests.

maria: Does this hit Private/VPC customers?

sam: Private may be unaffected if they pinned old images or run custom builds. Dedicated/hosted definitely using vulnerable binary.

jayden: If exploited, could leak request headers and possibly auth tokens if present in metadata. That touches SLA/incident risk.

security-bot: Created SEC-3241: CVE-2026-12345 - thrift-serializer remote deserial. Link: https://sec.redwood/SEC-3241

product-support: If hosted customers are exposed, what's our comm plan? SLA breach risk?

alex: Our triage rubric: public PoC + hosted impact -> P1. Target patch window = 72h normally, but with PoC we should accelerate to 24h canary rollout. Need to decide customer-tier messaging (Enterprise / Dedicated priority).

sre-oncall: Can we hotpatch the container? I can do a rolling shortest-window canary to 5% traffic and monitor for errors/latency. If stable, promote.

maria: Two compliance asks: 1) KMS rotation plan if any key material might've been referenced, 2) ensure audit logs capture any serializer/KMS access during investigation. Need owners.

sam: Proposed plan: 1) Patch thrift -> release new container image with fixed lib. 2) Canary 5% hosted immediately, monitor logs for anomalies and error budget. 3) If no regressions in 6 hours, promote to 100% for hosted. 4) Notify Dedicated customers and offer assisted rollout within 72 hours; Enterprise SLA get heads-up now. Private customers: advisory only.

jayden: +1. Also add a fallback: if latency spikes or errors > 0.5% in canary, rollback and open incident.

alex: I'll draft customer comms: expedited notice for Enterprise + Dedicated-managed, post-fix advisory for self-managed Private. Will include suggested mitigations.

maria: KMS team: can you confirm if any rotated keys were referenced by the serializer library? If yes, we need to rotate and log. @security-bot please create KMS audit task.

security-bot: Created TASK-4592: KMS audit & rotate keys if correlated with SEC-3241.

jayden: Starting canary deploy now (5% traffic) — will tag canary with label: cve-2026-12345-canary.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated by jayden for service inference-api -> image: inference:v2026-03-patch1 (label: cve-2026-12345-canary).

sam: Also ensure RBAC changes aren't needed for the patch rollout. We shouldn't change service-account permissions during emergency deploys unless required.

maria: Add audit logging for serializer API entry points and KMS calls; set retention to 90 days for this incident. I'll coordinate with compliance.

alex: Owners assigned: sam (triage lead), jayden (deploy lead), maria (compliance/KMS/audit), alex (customer comms). I'll update SEC-3241 and Slack thread.

sam: Ack. I'll push the PR for the patched lib and link SEC-3241.

jayden: Monitoring dashboards up — watch for increased 5xx, latency p50/p95, and unusual outbound connections.

sre-oncall: If we see exploit indicators, escalate to incident and notify security page.

product-support: Noted. I'll prep support templates per tier.

alex: Draft comms ready, will share in #announcements for legal review before sending to Enterprise customers.

maria: After rollout, we should run an automated audit to surface any anomalous deserialization events in the last 30 days. Add to postmortem.

sam: Good. I'll update SEC-3241 with timeline and next steps.

alex: Final decision for schedule: start canary now, promote in 6h if stable, full rollout within 24h for hosted. Dedicated: propose scheduled maintenance window in 48–72h unless customer requests immediate assistance. Private: advisory + patch instructions.

jayden: Roger. Rolling canary progress will be posted to this thread.

sam: Thanks all — owners please update tickets as actions complete.
